random neural networks and reservoir systems are capable of approximations of arbitrary functions, provided that they are sufficiently smooth, that this holds for both feedforward and recurrent architectures, and that the approximation rate is independent of the weight distribution, i.e. the weights may be drawn randomly from any distribution.
